name: course-crawler
description: Capture any online content as a clean local archive for knowledge bases. Single pages, full multi-lesson courses (Kajabi/Teachable/Thinkific/Skool classrooms/custom), and YouTube playlists. Detects the agentic browser you have, handles login (assisted or manual cookie paste), and outputs clean Markdown + categorized reference links + downloaded assets + slide frames + transcripts. Local GPU Whisper by default (Groq/OpenAI fallback). Works on Mac and Windows.
